highlights:
Mesh and overlay upper: Large mesh windows sit between synthetic leather panels around the front and quarter of this lace-up casual shoe.

Layered toe outline: A broad overlay wraps around the front and side of the rounded forefoot, creating a clearly defined toe profile.

Lace adjustment: The eyelet row runs along the centre opening above the tongue, allowing the lacing to be adjusted over the instep.

Segmented sole edge: Polygon-shaped sections along the dark sidewall form the distinctive outsole profile; a forefoot underside close-up shows the bottom texture.

Two colour directions: Black and Green are listed in EU39-44, each with matching panel and mesh geometry.
